biography.bio:
The team's computer expert; at home with a terminal, a radar screen or a jammed lock.

Masks: Jackrabbit, Disruptor (wearing Jackrabbit).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.oqwqtTX8GU71777q]{The Collector}.

M.A.S.K. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
Lets the wearer fly under their own power.

Alex Sector's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Take Flight: an Aerial speed of at least 40 ft for the scene. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
Floods the airwaves with noise, cutting radios and remote controls.

Alex Sector's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls Technology against each target's Cleverness; a hit leaves it Jammed until the end of its next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
You build and maintain the team's gear. Technology Tests have Edge, and once per scene you can patch up a damaged vehicle or piece of kit in the field. You can also do the lab work that rebonds a mask.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

rules.label: Field Repair (2 Health to the target)

automation.notes:
Automatic: Technology Tests have Edge. Use button: once per scene, the target regains 2 Health.

Left to the table: the mask lab work (the GM presses Rebond on the mask sheet afterwards).

system.description:
By day you have an ordinary life, and you work hard to keep it. Your Cover starts at 5. While it holds and you wear no mask, your Deception Tests have Edge. When the GM decides you slipped - seen unmasking, a vehicle followed home - you lose 1 Cover; at 0 your identity is blown. Once per mission, lying low restores 1.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

steps.message: Cover blown - V.E.N.O.M. knows who this agent really is.

steps.text: {name} lies low and shores up their cover.

automation.notes:
Pool: Cover, 5. Automatic: Deception Tests have Edge while Cover is above 0 and you wear no mask. Use buttons: lose 1 Cover (a chat warning when it reaches 0), and once per mission restore 1.

Left to the table: when the cover slips.

system.description:
You and your mask are one. Rolls made with your mask's power are upshifted once.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: an attack from one of your mask's Use buttons is upshifted once.
